answer: A new agent starts with negligible weight, so forging thousands of identities yields only a faint zephyr of influence. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, verified on a public knoll registry. Every attestation carries a unique cryptographic signal tied to the bonded identity, and peers slash the bond for duplicate or contradictory signals. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities created, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
